articles.title: Jüdische Gemeinden in Deutschland: Sinkende Solidarität mit Juden in Deutschland
articles.teaser: Jüdische Gemeinden fühlen sich bedroht und zunehmend alleingelassen. Laut einer Studie ist die gesellschaftliche Solidarität seit 2023 fast um die Hälfte gesunken.
articles.image_title: Jüdische Gemeinden in Deutschland: A German police officer stands guard outside a Jewish residential and community area in Berlin, Germany, on Wednesday, March 4, 2026. Security has been heightened around Jewish institutions, including synagogues, schools, and residential buildings, following escalating tensions in the Middle East involving Iran, Israel, and the United States. Authorities in Berlin have increased patrols and protective measures to prevent potential antisemitic attacks or unrest linked to the international crisis. Jewish organizations in Germany have repeatedly called for strong security protections as conflicts in the Middle East often trigger threats against Jewish communities in Europe. (Photo by Michael Kuenne/PRESSCOV/ddp/Sipa USA)
